english.title: Make a prohibited payment regarding adoption / consent to adoptions / removal from UK of a child
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[made]_
(B)_[agreed to make]_
(C)_[offered to make]_
(D)_[received]_
(E)_[agreed to receive]_
(F)_[attempted to obtain]_

payment for or in consideration of

(G)_[the adoption of a child]_
(H)_[giving consent required in connection with the adoption of a child]_
(I)_[removing from the United Kingdom a child who was a Commonwealth citizen to a place outside the British Islands for the purpose of adoption]_
(J)_[removing from the United Kingdom a child who was habitually resident in the United Kingdom, to a place outside the British Islands for the purpose of adoption]_
(K)_[a person, who was neither an adoption agency nor acting in pursuance of an order of the High Court, taking a step mentioned in section 92(2) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002]_
(L)_[preparing a report in contravention of section 94(1) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002]_
(M)_[causing a report to be prepared in contravention of section 94(1) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002]_
(N)_[submitting a report, the preparation of which contravened section 94(1) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002]_

other.penalty:
Summary: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months and / or a fine not exceeding £10,000.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
